g.text: Qwen3.8-27B · throughput vs full HTTP latency
M5 Ultra 256 GiB · identical NVFP4 weights / D prompts · normal EOS, cap 512 · formal observers OFF
14 measured points: native 1 process per C; oMLX and Lithos 3 processes per C. C1 is enlarged in each inset.
Black outlines: nondominated observed points only. 8 warm + 64 formal requests per process; queueing included.
Separate measurement cycles; no paired CI or interpolation. Lithos C8 is HTTP concurrency with FIFO GPU execution.
E024 route graph: serving-state checks passed; actual HTTP qualification and formal speed remain pending.
Protocol/count qualification does not establish cross-engine full-state or answer-quality equality.
oMLX: separate post-run audit parser correction; original failed audit receipts are preserved.
